# City Hero Kit: Motion Directions

All images are wide, copy-safe compositions intended for restrained motion rather than fast video loops. Use a gentle 10- to 14-second loop, respect prefers-reduced-motion, and keep text stationary.

## Tracy
- `tracy-altamont-windmills-hero.png`: slow 3% push toward the left foreground turbine; turbine blades can rotate very slowly in a separate video treatment.
- `tracy-city-windfarm-aerial.png`: slow horizontal drift from the water tower toward the wind farm.

## Mountain House
- `mountain-house-windmills-hero.png`: slow upward push from neighborhood roofs to distant turbines.
- `mountain-house-greenbelt-twilight.png`: gentle right-to-left pan along the curving path; subtle light shimmer only.

## River Islands
- `river-islands-lakefront-hero.png`: slow push across water; animate tiny water ripples and tree movement only.
- `river-islands-blue-hour-waterfront.png`: slow drift over shoreline reflections; never add boats or busy movement.

## Lathrop
- `lathrop-levee-water-hero.png`: slow path-following push toward the horizon; soft reed motion and subtle water ripple.
- `lathrop-levee-sunrise.png`: slow lateral pan along the levee; keep the low sun calm and natural.

## Manteca
- `manteca-water-tower-hero.png`: slow push from tree canopy to water tower; light leaf movement only.
- `manteca-orchard-neighborhood.png`: slow left-to-right pan from orchard edge toward neighborhood homes.

## DW Woodbridge
- `dw-woodbridge-clubhouse-hero.png`: slow push toward the clubhouse; fountain and reflections are the only live movement.
- `dw-woodbridge-bocce-garden.png`: slow garden-level drift toward the pavilion; warm late-day light, no people required.
